# REA + Ghidra Toolkit

> Generic, reusable methods and tools for authorized static analysis with REA and Ghidra. This repository should not receive target binaries, decompiled artifacts, proprietary specifications, private results, or secrets.

## What this is for

Native, unmanaged Windows binaries in PE32 format — with dedicated guidance for classic 32-bit Delphi (VMT / RTTI). Not for managed runtimes (.NET / Java), not for PE32+ 64-bit images, not for execution-based debugging or malware triage. Static analysis only; observation, inference, and unknown stay separated.

## Start here for agents

1. Read the workflow first, then use only the relevant specialized page.
2. Work with the target that is actually present and the tools that are actually registered; do not invent tool names or observations.
3. Separate observation, inference, and unknown. VMT hits, strings, and plausible pseudocode are not complete behavioral validation.
4. Use generality in GitMCP queries and avoid pasting private target content or secrets.
5. Only move cleaned, legally safe, general knowledge back into this toolkit. Target-specific results remain in the private project.

## Documentation

- [Analysis workflow](https://github.com/ethanhunt1981/rea-ghidra-toolkit/blob/main/docs/workflow.md): order of artifact identity, inventory, focused decompilation, reconstruction, and verification.
- [REA + Ghidra](https://github.com/eethanhunt1981/rea-ghidra-toolkit/blob/main/docs/rea-ghidra.md): focused REA workflow and Ghidra headless fallback.
- [Delphi PE32](https://github.com/ethanhunt1981/rea-ghidra-toolkit/blob/main/docs/delphi-pe32.md): VMT and RTTI care, address kinds, and safe handling of heuristics.
- [Evidence](https://github.com/ethanhunt1981/rea-ghidra-toolkit/blob/main/docs/evidence.md): claim ledger, address clarity, coverage, and handover.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/ethanhunt1981/rea-ghidra-toolkit/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): diagnose without repeating a failed call.
- [GitMCP + OpenCode](https://github.com/ethanhunt1981/rea-ghidra-toolkit/blob/main/docs/gitmcp.md): integration and useful prompts.

## Tools

- [PE32 inventory](https://github.com/ethanhunt1981/rea-ghidra-toolkit/blob/main/tools/pe_inventory.py): hash, header, sections and optional imports.
- [Delphi VMT](https://github.com/ethanhunt1981/rea-ghidra-toolkit/blob/main/tools/delphi_vmt.py): individual candidate or heuristic scan; all hits remain unverified until the disassembler supports them.
- [PE32 kernel](https://github.com/ethanhunt1981/rea-ghidra-toolkit/blob/main/tools/pe32.py): read-only RVA/VA mapping and basic PE32 parsing.
- [Ghidra export](https://github.com/ethanhunt1981/rea-ghidra-toolkit/blob/main/ghidra/scripts/ExportDecompilation.java): one UTF-8 file with non-external function names, entry points, signatures, and decompiled C.
